'''Mr. Shellby''' (Japanese: '''タマゾウ''' ''Tamazō'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP228|Extreme Pokémon!]]''.

Mr. Shellby lives in the town of [[Eggseter]] with [[Kimie|his wife]]. They own the Shellby [[Pokémon Day Care|Ranch]], and call themselves Pokémon Nesters; people who take care of [[Pokémon Egg]]s, as well as the babies after they hatch until they become older to care for themselves.

In addition to working at the Ranch, the Shellbys also help out during the town's annual [[Extreme Pokémon Race|Extreme Pokémon competition]]. All competitors in the race must pick up a dummy Egg at the Shellby Ranch and carry it back to the finish line. {{Ash}} was successfully able to do this. As a reward for this, and as a thank you from the Shellbys for saving their Pokémon, they gave him an Egg that hatched into a {{AP|Phanpy}}.

He was mentioned by Ash and {{an|Brock}} in ''[[EP230|Hatching a Plan]]''.
